scientific_limitations: Only the rank-one coupling family on a complex coordinatewise Banach lattice is classified.
The operators are reducible and not power-bounded; full peripheral spectrum remains cyclic.
No assertion of irreducibility, stochasticity or a universal classification of positive operators.
Older equivalent positive rank-one block constructions remain a publication-priority risk, despite direct full-text comparison with the motivating work.
title: Finite Fourier eigenvalue strata of positive rank-one shift perturbations
